'''Jervo's World''' was a name given to a large network of [[Swoopdueling/Legends|swoopdueling]] arenas above [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]] owned by [[Lhosan Industries]]. It was named after its owner, [[Jervo Thalien]].

==Description==
The station consisted of 12 satellite arenas connected to the central [[Hub Arena|Hub]] and each other by 24 scream tubes. The arena pods themselves were quite large, suggesting the massive nature of the whole station.
